voice.name: Carolyn - Warm Grounded Narrator
voice.source: ElevenLabs GET /v1/shared-voices (gender=female), vom Nutzer gewaehlt aus Carolyn/Fernanda/Sedona

sentences.text: A year from now, you'll be somewhere.
This path is flat. Easy. Familiar.
Same job. Same habits. Same excuses.
One step a day. Nobody claps. Nobody watches.
But every step changes the view.
Both roads take exactly one year.
Only one of them takes you higher.
So, a year from now... where will you be?

mood_cue.calm: she said calmly and warmly, like a trusted mentor.
